The small crab stands on its legs and breathes, its claws bobbing slightly, the fork held upright in its right claw, the helmet plume swaying a little.
The crab scuttles sideways quickly on its many legs, body low, fork held upright.
The crab crouches low and draws the fork back beside its body, raising its left claw, and holds that ready pose.
The crab lunges forward and thrusts the fork straight ahead while snapping its left claw, then pulls back.
The crab recoils backward, the helmet tilting, then steadies.
The crab tips over onto its back, its legs curl up and it lies still, the fork lying beside it.
The golden fish hovers upright, gently swaying, its fins and long tail fluttering softly.
The golden fish swims forward with its body and tail waving side to side.
The golden fish curls its body and tail back like a spring, fins flared, and holds.
The golden fish darts forward in a quick straight lunge, mouth open, then straightens back.
The golden fish jerks backward, its fins flaring, then recovers.
The golden fish flips belly up and sinks down to the ground, lying still on its side.
The hermit crab sits in its teapot and breathes, its claws and eye stalks bobbing slightly.
The hermit crab crawls forward on its little legs, dragging the teapot shell, which rocks slightly.
The hermit crab pulls its claws, legs and eye stalks back inside the teapot until only the teapot is left, and stays hidden inside.
The hermit crab snaps both claws forward out of the teapot in a quick pinch, then pulls them back.
The hermit crab flinches, the teapot jolting, then settles.
The hermit crab slumps out of the teapot, its claws flopping onto the ground, and the teapot tips onto its side; it lies still.
The sea anemone sways gently: its soft tentacles wave slowly and the big eye blinks; the shell stays still.
The scallop shell scoots forward in small hops, the tentacles swaying.
The sea anemone draws all its tentacles tightly inward and leans back, the eye narrowing, and holds.
The sea anemone thrusts all its tentacles forward and outward in a quick fan, then lets them sway back.
The sea anemone recoils, the tentacles flinching inward, then they relax.
The sea anemone wilts: the tentacles droop and sag down over the shell, the eye closes.
The flying fish hovers, gently flapping its feathered wings, its body bobbing.
The flying fish glides forward, beating its feathered wings in a steady rhythm.
The flying fish pulls its wings back and tucks its body low, ready to leap, and holds.
The flying fish leaps up high with its wings spread, then dives down steeply head first, then levels out.
The flying fish jerks back in the air, wings flaring, then recovers.
The flying fish falls to the ground, its wings folding, and lies on its side.
The small round pufferfish floats, bobbing gently, its little fins fluttering.
The pufferfish swims forward, its tiny fins paddling quickly and the body wobbling.
The pufferfish puffs up: its body stretches rounder, the spikes stand straight out, the cheeks bulge, and it trembles.
The puffed-up pufferfish jolts and shudders hard, then its body relaxes back to normal.
The pufferfish recoils backward with a wobble, then recovers.
The pufferfish flips belly up and drops to the ground, lying still.
The jellyfish floats and bobs gently up and down, its tentacles waving softly below.
The jellyfish drifts forward, its dome pulsing and the tentacles trailing behind.
The jellyfish squeezes its dome and pulls its tentacles up tight beneath it, rising slightly, and holds.
The jellyfish swings all its tentacles down and forward in one strong pulse, then lets them float back.
The jellyfish wobbles backward, tentacles flailing, then steadies.
The jellyfish sinks down to the ground, its tentacles going limp and spreading out flat.
The round sea urchin sits and breathes, its spines rising and settling slightly, its little eyes blinking.
The sea urchin rolls forward slowly on its spines, wobbling.
The sea urchin bristles: all its spines push straight out and it presses down, trembling, and holds.
The sea urchin spins around in place on the spot, its spines bristling, turning over and over.
The sea urchin flinches, its spines flattening for a moment, then bristling back.
The sea urchin sags and flattens, its spines drooping, and lies still.
The big crab general stands and breathes, its claws bobbing, the banner on its back swaying slightly.
The crab general marches sideways on its many legs with heavy steps, claws raised.
The crab general raises its huge claw high and opens it wide, leaning back, and holds.
The crab general slams its huge open claw forward and snaps it shut, then pulls it back.
The crab general recoils, its helmet tilting back, then steadies.
The crab general collapses, its legs buckle and it slumps flat onto the ground with its claws spread out.
The crab general spreads both claws wide apart to the sides, wide open, and holds.
The crab general swings both claws inward so they cross in front of its body in a scissor snap, then opens them again.
The crab general raises both claws straight up high above its head and holds them there.
The crab general slams both raised claws down onto the ground in front of it, then lifts them back up.
The huge pufferfish king floats, bobbing slowly, its fins fluttering and lips pouting.
The pufferfish king swims forward slowly, fins paddling, the body wobbling.
The pufferfish king puffs up: its body stretches rounder, spikes standing straight out, cheeks bulging, trembling, and holds.
The puffed-up pufferfish king tilts forward and rocks back and forth, forward and back, as if rolling along.
The pufferfish king recoils backward with a wobble, then recovers.
The pufferfish king flips belly up and sinks to the ground, lying still.
